fact: The Egg Chamber is a dark cavern in the Underdark containing a mysterious and coveted egg.
source_quote: Deep within the Underdark, the party found themselves locked in a desperate struggle to protect a mysterious and coveted egg hidden within a dark cavern.
subject: Egg Chamber

fact: The Egg Chamber is blanketed in magical darkness.
source_quote: the magical darkness that blanketed the chamber turned the fight into a fumbling, frantic melee.
subject: Egg Chamber

fact: Derro cultists swarm the chamber with fanatical purpose, having minds twisted by sinister forces.
source_quote: The Derro cultists, their minds twisted beyond reason by the manipulations of sinister forces, swarmed the chamber with fanatical purpose.
subject: Derro cultists

fact: The Derro cooperate out of necessity and when riled up by a charismatic leader.
source_quote: they cooperate "out of necessity and when riled up by a charismatic leader,"
subject: Derro cultists

fact: The Derro have a history as slaves to Mind Flayers.
source_quote: The party discusses the madness of the Derro and their history as slaves to Mind Flayers.
subject: Derro cultists

fact: A spectator is a multi-eyed, beholder-like creature that appears from the darkness to join the assault.
source_quote: From the shadows, hidden spies loosed crossbow bolts at the party's allies... a beholder-kin creature known as a spectator materialized from the darkness, its many eyes gleaming with malice as it joined the assault.
subject: Spectator

fact: The party has previously met the spectator.
source_quote: It spends all its movement arriving; the GM notes "You've met it before."
subject: Spectator

fact: Plinki is the fanatical leader of the Derro.
source_quote: killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright and leaving the survivors blinded and reeling.
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki was grappled by Zalthir at the end of the previous chapter.
source_quote: Opening situation, carried over from chapter 19: Plinki has been grappled (by Zalthir, at the end of chapter 19)
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki attempts to attack Gyrgum but fails due to the surrounding darkness.
source_quote: Plinki attempts to attack Gyrgum but fails to land a blow due to the surrounding darkness.
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki's mind is focused solely on attacking Gyrgum.
source_quote: GM: "he's got only one thing on his mind. He wants to attack Gyrgum."
subject: Plinki

fact: Eldeth is struck by a crossbow bolt from a Derro spy, dropping to four hit points.
source_quote: one bolt striking Eldeth with brutal force and dropping her to the edge of death.
subject: Eldeth

fact: Eldeth takes 12 points of damage from the crossbow bolt.
source_quote: Eldeth takes 12 points of damage and is down to four hit points.
subject: Eldeth

fact: Daz conjures a massive hand of compacted earth that seizes the spectator.
source_quote: Daz conjured a massive hand of compacted earth that surged up from the ground and seized the spectator, pinning it in place
subject: Daz

fact: Daz deals 16 damage to the spectator with the earthen hand.
source_quote: 16 damage; the spectator is restrained
subject: Daz

fact: Daz retreats into the darkness after conjuring the hand.
source_quote: Daz then retreats into the darkness so he can't be targeted.
subject: Daz

fact: Daz has a plan to steal the egg.
source_quote: GM: Daz already has a plan to steal the egg.
subject: Daz

fact: Zalthir can perceive through supernatural darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir, gifted with the ability to perceive through the supernatural darkness, moved with deadly precision, striking at enemies that could not even see him coming.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir maneuvers through his own magical darkness to strike at the Derro.
source_quote: Zalthir maneuvers through his own magical darkness to strike at the Derro.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir unleashes a breath attack in a cone, killing Plinki and blinding others.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed a terrifying breath that swept across the chamber in a wide cone, killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright and leaving the survivors blinded and reeling.
subject: Zalthir

fact: Gyrgum was sitting over the eggs at the start of the scene.
source_quote: Gyrgum was sitting over the eggs
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum is willing to steal the egg to protect it.
source_quote: Gyrgum's player: "So I want to protect this egg, but I'm willing to steal it if that's the best way to do that."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum calls upon a ghostly ally to defend the egg.
source_quote: Gyrgum called upon his ghostly ally to defend the egg
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum's ghostly ally acts on his turn because he 'has the bones'.
source_quote: it acts on Gyrgum's turn "because you have the bones."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Thorin engages a Derro warrior using his longsword to impose disadvantage on the enemy's next attack.
source_quote: Thorin engages a Derro warrior, utilizing his longsword to impose disadvantage on the enemy's next attack.
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin is learning the Sentinel feat.
source_quote: Thorin's player is learning his new Sentinel feat ("defend other people. People can't disengage").
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin hits derro #6 for 9 damage with Blindsight giving him advantage.
source_quote: Blindsight in the darkness gives him advantage; he hits derro #6 for 9
subject: Thorin

fact: A Derro spy emerges from the shadows and severely wounds Eldeth with a crossbow bolt.
source_quote: A Derro spy emerges from the shadows and severely wounds Eldeth with a crossbow bolt.
subject: Derro spy ambush

fact: A second spy attempts to shoot Daz but misses.
source_quote: A second spy attempts to shoot Daz but misses.
subject: Second spy miss

fact: A Derro marches up and swings at Zalthir with disadvantage, rolling a 15 against AC 16 for a miss.
source_quote: A Derro marches up and swings at Zalthir with disadvantage, rolling a 15 against AC 16 — a miss.
subject: Derro miss vs Zalthir

fact: Thorin's longsword's Sap mastery gives the target disadvantage on its next attack.
source_quote: and his longsword's Sap mastery gives the target disadvantage on its next attack.
subject: Thorin's Sap mastery

fact: One of the party helpers hits the spectator for 10 damage.
source_quote: One of the helpers hits the spectator for 10.
subject: Helper attacks spectator

fact: Enemy crossbowmen fire blindly, with one hitting Gyrgum for six damage.
source_quote: Enemy crossbowmen fire blindly: one hits Gyrgum for six
subject: Crossbowmen blind fire

fact: Plinki is killed by Zalthir's breath attack.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed a terrifying breath that swept across the chamber in a wide cone, killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright
subject: Plinki's death

fact: Zalthir's breath attack inflicts the blinded condition on the surviving Derro.
source_quote: it kills Plinki and inflicts the blinded condition; others take one or two points.
subject: Blinding condition

fact: Plinki is dead, killed by Zalthir's breath attack.
source_quote: killing the fanatical Derro leader Plinki outright
subject: Plinki

fact: The Spectator is restrained by Daz's conjured earthen hand.
source_quote: Daz conjured a massive hand of compacted earth that surged up from the ground and seized the spectator, pinning it in place
